name: nested-outlook-thread
description: Outlook email from Varun (account manager) with deeply nested quoted history. The thread is a long API integration follow-up about sandbox credentials and a go-live checklist for helpdesk ticket 400123, with ~12 levels of nested replies/forwards going back to early March 2026. Fully synthetic: the cast is the project's pseudonym set, the customer is Acme (partner.example), and the typos in the customer's nudges are deliberate (bodies must stay verbatim). This is the canonical 'first email of a long Outlook thread' test case. Both gpt-oss-120b and sarv-mati-flash struggled with this shape in production — gpt-oss returned only 1 message, sarv-mati truncated at 256 tokens with garbled output.
